topic: ホルムズ海峡を通航する船舶への20％通航料をめぐる発言の撤回と市場反応

sentences: This episode looks at a changing U.S. plan for ships using the Strait of Hormuz and its effect on oil markets.
Listen for why oil prices stayed uncertain and what worried shipping companies.
